apply: --apply --enable-matching-writes; default/--dry-run is SELECT-only plan and does not classify source rows
matching_service: RuntimeIdentityService.reconcile(...,include_offer_selection=False); same match_cards, PostgresRepository.persist_match, classify_identity_card and review sync

source_products: catalog_product_id (accept or guarded automatic quarantine only)
product_identity_decisions: product_kind (decision metadata only; not ingestion raw_data)

defaults: Associated table-generated IDs/sequences and created_at defaults; existing per-product transactions/history semantics reused. Apply is not one atomic2449-row transaction; independently gated future execution must retain receipts on partial failure.
prerequisites: Nonempty active PostgreSQL registry, complete catalog_product_id bootstrap, exact eligible source counts; service rechecks registry before matching/persistence; no registry load inside entrypoint
